**Finding: deviation (medium) — Section 7.3 warranty period and missing services warranty.**

What I found:
- **§7.3 (p0078):** Software/MarketSite.net conformance warranty lasts only **60 days from the Effective Date, hard-capped at December 31, 1999** — and acceptance testing under §3.1 can itself run to December 31, 1999, so the warranty may lapse at or before acceptance. This falls short of both our 12-month preferred position and the 90-day fallback. The malicious-code warranty is present but tied to the same short period.
- **§7.3 remedy (p0079):** Acceptable — commercially reasonable correction, replacement, and termination with refund of prepaid fees if the breach cannot be corrected.
- **§5 services (installation, implementation, support, training, professional services):** no professional/workmanlike warranty at all.
- **Disclaimer (p0084):** only a truncated fragment ("...OTHERWISE, INCLUDING WITHOUT LIMITATION THE IMPLIED WARRANTIES...") survives in the document, so no evidence it swallows the express warranties; no edit proposed there.

Redline validated (ok:true) and submitted:
1. §7.3 — replace "sixty (60) days from the Effective Date, but in no event not later than December 31, 1999" with "twelve (12) months from Corio's acceptance of the Software".
2. New §7.5 — services performed in a professional and workmanlike manner, deliverables conforming to documentation for 90 days, with re-performance/repair/replacement/refund remedy.

Fallback offered in the comment: 90 days for the Software warranty if Commerce One resists 12 months.
